The hamster has dense, reddish-brown fur, a stocky body, and is facing left. Its head features a dark eye, small rounded ears, and prominent whiskers. The background includes a blurry green object to the left and some green leafy material in the foreground.

A single dark, bead-like eye is clearly visible on the side of the head, matching the description.
The visible ear is small, rounded, and covered in fur, consistent with hamster anatomy.
